name: Pudhumai Penn Scheme (Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme)
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
summary: Assists girl students who studied in government schools from classes 6 to 12 in continuing their higher education by providing financial assistance.
eligibility: Must have studied in Government Schools in Tamil Nadu from Class 6 to Class 12.
Must be enrolled in a recognized higher education course (degree, diploma, or professional course).
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹1,000 per month paid directly into the student's bank account till the completion of the course.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the dedicated Pudhumai Penn portal or via college administration.
Provide Government School Transfer Certificate (TC) and study certificate.
Provide bank account details linked to Aadhaar.
language_notes: Also known as Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Scheme.
source_type: Official Tamil Nadu Social Welfare Portal

name: Chief Minister's Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme (CMCHIS)
department: Health and Family Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
summary: Provides comprehensive health insurance coverage to families to enable them to access quality medical care for covered surgeries, diagnostic procedures, and treatments.
eligibility: Must be a resident family of Tamil Nadu.
Family annual income must be below the official threshold (currently ₹1,20,000 per annum for scheme enrolment).
Should hold a valid CMCHIS Smart Card.
benefits: Cashless health insurance coverage up to ₹5,00,000 (5 Lakhs) per family per year for listed medical and surgical procedures in empaneled hospitals.
how_to_apply: Visit the District Collectorate office or CMCHIS kiosk with Smart Card/Ration Card and Income Certificate.
Get enrolled, complete biometric registration, and receive the CMCHIS Smart Card.
language_notes: Known in Tamil as முதலமைச்சரின் விரிவான மருத்துவக் காப்பீட்டுத் திட்டம்.

name: First Generation Graduation Tuition Fee Waiver Scheme
department: Directorate of Technical Education (DOTE), Government of Tamil Nadu
summary: Waives tuition fees for students pursuing professional courses who are the first graduates in their families, helping them access engineering, medicine, and other courses.
eligibility: Must be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
The student must be the first person in their family (including siblings, parents, and grandparents) to graduate from college.
Must secure admission under government quota through single window counseling.
benefits: Concession/waiver of tuition fees for professional courses as determined by government guidelines.
how_to_apply: Obtain a First Graduate Certificate from the Revenue Department (Tahsildar) via e-Sevai centers.
Submit the First Graduate Certificate during admission counseling or college admission.
language_notes: Also referred to as First Graduate Tuition Fee Waiver.
source_type: Official Directorate of Technical Education Page

name: Collegiate Education Scholarships
department: Directorate of Collegiate Education (DCE), Government of Tamil Nadu
summary: Offers a collection of scholarship schemes for eligible students pursuing collegiate education in arts, science, commerce, and postgraduate studies.
eligibility: Must be enrolled in a recognized government, government-aided, or self-financing college in Tamil Nadu.
Must fulfill specific scheme criteria (such as community categories, low family income, or merit).
benefits: Financial assistance for college fees, book allowances, and maintenance allowance based on the specific collegiate scholarship category.
how_to_apply: Apply online via the DCE Scholarship portal or submit physical applications to the college scholarship clerk/officer.
Provide community certificate, income certificate, bank passbook details, and marks sheets.
language_notes: Lists multiple schemes like EVR Nagammai, Post Matric, and State level scholarships.
source_type: Official Directorate of Collegiate Education Portal

name: Women Empowerment and Collegiate Education Incentives
department: Directorate of Collegiate Education (DCE), Government of Tamil Nadu
summary: Promotes higher education enrollment of women by highlighting specific empowerment schemes, incentives, safety rules, and hostels available for female collegiate students.
eligibility: Enrolled in higher education courses in colleges in Tamil Nadu.
benefits: Access to safe government women hostels, transport concessions, counseling, and specific cash/book incentives under women-empowerment guidelines.
how_to_apply: Inquire through the college principal or collegiate education portal for available hostel allocations and incentives.
language_notes: Encompasses safety measures and special provisions for women students.
source_type: Official Directorate of Collegiate Education Portal
